examples: Leave a terminal in the background: when its agent finishes, the tab gets a neon comet until you open it.
Slow the lap to 10 seconds on a quiet screen, or turn the comet off.
how_to: When a terminal window's session is done and unread (the green outline light), or asleep and flagged for follow-up (the green moon), is asking you something, or wants your attention, a comet laps the window's border. A session in a background tab gets the comet on its tab instead.
It stops the moment the state clears: viewing, focusing or marking read; the question answered; the notice dealt with.
Open settings, appearance, motion, comet on attention: the switch (on by default), the lap time in seconds (0.5 to 30, default 3) and the unread comet color (celestial, unread green, theme accent).
Shared with your other devices; an agent can set it with the preferences_update tool (fields comet_on, comet_lap_seconds, comet_unread_color).
The animations switch, a blurred window, low power and Reduce Motion hold it; with Reduce Motion it is a still glow.
name: Attention comet
summary: a neon comet laps the border of a terminal window or background tab whose session is done and unread, asking or noticing; on by default.
where: A terminal window's border, or a background terminal tab; Settings, appearance, motion, comet on attention.
